provenance.evidence: The registry mapped row_buff and col_buff to the same buff kwarg, so a call with both became 'buff=0.5, buff=0.3' (SyntaxError: keyword argument repeated). ManimGL arrange_in_grid takes h_buff and v_buff.

stderr: TypeError: arrange_in_grid() got an unexpected keyword argument 'row_buff'
notes: Both row_buff and col_buff on one call must map to v_buff and h_buff and still compile.
